name: roslyn-workspace-follow
description: Keeps RoslynMcp on the Codex session workspace before Roslyn tool calls.

interface.shortDescription: Keep RoslynMcp on the current Codex workspace.
interface.longDescription: Calls set_solution_root before each Roslyn MCP tool so a Codex worktree handoff cannot leave RoslynMcp on the previous checkout.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check which solution RoslynMcp is using.
